# Chili's Grill & Bar

> > American casual dining restaurant chain featuring signature items like Big Mouth Burgers, Triple Dipper, Chicken Crispers, and fajitas with locations nationwide.

Chili's Grill & Bar is a popular casual dining restaurant offering a diverse menu of American favorites including burgers, fajitas, appetizers, and specialty items. The site provides location-specific menus, online ordering for pickup and delivery, party platters, and to-go alcohol options at participating locations.

## Key Topics

- Big Mouth Burgers
- Triple Dipper
- Chicken Crispers
- 3 For Me
- Southwestern Eggrolls
- Fajitas
- The Original Trio
- Guiltless Grill
- Party Platters
- Casual Dining
- American Food
- To-Go Alcohol
- Online Ordering
- Appetizers & Entrees
